constraints.name: operators_name_check
constraints.definition: char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length(initials) BETWEEN 1 AND 4

constraints.name: auth_sessions_active_device_idx
constraints.definition: (device_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND device_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: auth_sessions_biometric_device_check
constraints.definition: method <> 'BIOMETRIC' OR device_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: auth_sessions_times_check
constraints.definition: last_seen_at >= issued_at AND absolute_expires_at > issued_at AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: auth_sessions_token_reuse_check
constraints.definition: end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'TOKEN_REUSE' OR method = 'BIOMETRIC'

constraints.name: pairing_codes_times_check
constraints.definition: expires_at > issued_at AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: pairing_codes_closed_check
constraints.definition: (state = 'ACTIVE') = (closed_at IS NULL) AND (closed_by_operator_id IS NULL OR state = 'CANCELLED')

constraints.name: paired_devices_text_check
constraints.definition: char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length(platform) BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND char_length(app_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 32

constraints.name: paired_devices_lifecycle_check
constraints.definition: (state = 'PAIRED' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revoked_by_operator_id IS NULL AND revoke_reason IS NULL AND unpaired_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'REVOKED' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_by_operator_id IS NOT NULL AND char_length(revoke_reason) BETWEEN 5 AND 500 AND unpaired_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'UNPAIRED' AND unpaired_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revoked_by_operator_id IS NULL AND revoke_reason IS NULL)

constraints.name: device_credentials_lengths_check
constraints.definition: octet_length(current_hash) = 32 AND (next_hash IS NULL OR (octet_length(next_hash) = 32 AND next_hash <> current_hash))

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_one_live_key
constraints.definition: (device_id, operator_id) WHERE used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_live_operator_idx
constraints.definition: (operator_id) WHERE used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_times_check
constraints.definition: expires_at > issued_at AND (used_at IS NULL OR used_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_revoke_check
constraints.definition: ("biometric_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("biometric_tokens"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) AND ("biometric_tokens"."revoke_reason" IS NULL OR "biometric_tokens"."revoke_reason" IN ('DISABLED', 'REENROLLED', 'TOKEN_REUSE', 'DEVICE_REVOKED', 'DEVICE_UNPAIRED', 'USER_DISABLED', 'CREDENTIAL_REPLACED'))

constraints.name: audit_log_actor_id_seq_idx
constraints.definition: (actor_id, seq) WHERE actor_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: audit_log_session_id_seq_idx
constraints.definition: (session_id, seq) WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: audit_log_evidence_id_seq_idx
constraints.definition: (evidence_id, seq) WHERE evidence_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: active_session_time_source_check
constraints.definition: (start_time_source IS NULL OR start_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND (stop_time_source IS NULL OR stop_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

constraints.name: active_session_json_check
constraints.definition: jsonb_typeof("active_session"."precheck") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."finalization") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."timeline") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("active_session"."timeline") <= 200 AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."notes") = 'array' AND ("active_session"."fault" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("active_session"."fault") = 'object') AND ("active_session"."recovery" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("active_session"."recovery") = 'object') AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."capture_config") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."audio_source") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."transcript_status") = 'object'

constraints.name: session_history_values_check
constraints.definition: duration_ms >= 0 AND size_bytes >= 0 AND ended_at >= created_at

constraints.name: session_history_time_source_check
constraints.definition: (start_time_source IS NULL OR start_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND (end_time_source IS NULL OR end_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

constraints.name: session_history_outcome_check
constraints.definition: "session_history"."outcome" IN ('SEALED', 'INCOMPLETE') AND ("session_history"."fault_kind" IS NULL OR ("session_history"."outcome" = 'INCOMPLETE' AND "session_history"."fault_kind" IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER', 'MIC_SILENT', 'CAPTURE_FAULT')))

constraints.name: evidence_items_input_check
constraints.definition: subject_type IN ('TERSANGKA', 'SAKSI', 'LAINNYA') AND profile_id IN ('STANDARD_1080P25') AND (case_type IS NULL OR case_type IN ('TERSANGKA', 'SAKSI', 'LAINNYA'))

constraints.name: evidence_items_tamper_check
constraints.definition: tampered_track_id IS NULL OR tampered_track_id IN ('VIDEO-01', 'VIDEO-02', 'AUDIO-01', 'AUDIO-02')

constraints.name: evidence_items_values_check
constraints.definition: duration_ms >= 0 AND size_bytes >= 0 AND ended_at >= recorded_at AND (sealed_at IS NULL OR sealed_at >= ended_at)

constraints.name: evidence_items_signature_check
constraints.definition: "evidence_items"."signature_algorithm" IN ('SIMULATED-SHA256', 'Ed25519', 'ECDSA-P256-SHA256') AND (("evidence_items"."signature_algorithm" = 'SIMULATED-SHA256' AND "evidence_items"."signature_simulated") OR ("evidence_items"."signature_algorithm" IN ('Ed25519', 'ECDSA-P256-SHA256') AND NOT "evidence_items"."signature_simulated"))

constraints.name: evidence_items_sources_check
constraints.definition: ("evidence_items"."integrity_source" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."integrity_source" IN ('DEMO_PACKAGE', 'SIMULATED', 'REAL')) AND ("evidence_items"."start_time_source" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."start_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND ("evidence_items"."end_time_source" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."end_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

constraints.name: evidence_tracks_track_check
constraints.definition: track_id IN ('VIDEO-01', 'VIDEO-02', 'AUDIO-01', 'AUDIO-02') AND position BETWEEN 1 AND 4

constraints.name: evidence_tracks_values_check
constraints.definition: "evidence_tracks"."size_bytes" >= 0 AND "evidence_tracks"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ("evidence_tracks"."codec" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."codec" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$') AND ("evidence_tracks"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."duration_ms" >= 0) AND ("evidence_tracks"."fragment_count" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."fragment_count" >= 0) AND ("evidence_tracks"."fragment_chain_head" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."fragment_chain_head" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("evidence_tracks"."sha256_plain" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."sha256_plain" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

constraints.name: exports_scope_check
constraints.definition: scope IN ('EVIDENCE', 'AUDIT', 'LOGS') AND ((scope = 'EVIDENCE') = (evidence_id IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: storage_policy_values_check
constraints.definition: retention_policy IN ('DAYS_30', 'DAYS_90', 'YEAR_1', 'CASE_CLOSURE') AND retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3650

constraints.name: core_state_values_check
constraints.definition: scenario IN ('idle', 'recording', 'finalizing', 'fault-demo') AND epoch >= 0 AND sim_schema_version >= 1

constraints.name: hardware_snapshot_shapes_check
constraints.definition: jsonb_typeof(cameras) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(mics) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(services) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(other_devices) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(ports) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(tablet_link) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(storage) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(time_status) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(network) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(security) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(health) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(faults) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(software_update) = 'object' AND (diagnostics IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(diagnostics) = 'object')

constraints.name: health_snapshots_states_check
constraints.definition: storage_state IN ('READY', 'LOW', 'FULL') AND time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC') AND security_state IN ('READY', 'FAULT') AND (session_state IS NULL OR session_state IN ('CREATE', 'PRECHECK', 'ARMED', 'RECORDING', 'STOPPING', 'FINALIZING', 'SEALED', 'FAULT', 'RECOVERY')) AND active_faults >= 0

constraints.name: health_snapshots_cause_check
constraints.definition: "health_snapshots"."cause" IN ('INTERVAL', 'FAULT_RAISED', 'FAULT_CLEARED') AND (("health_snapshots"."cause" = 'INTERVAL') = ("health_snapshots"."fault_kind" IS NULL)) AND ("health_snapshots"."fault_kind" IS NULL OR "health_snapshots"."fault_kind" IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER', 'MIC_SILENT', 'CAPTURE_FAULT'))

constraints.name: audit_chain_history_values_check
constraints.definition: row_count >= 1 AND first_seq >= 1 AND last_seq >= first_seq

constraints.name: capture_devices_text_check
constraints.definition: ("capture_devices"."model" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."model") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."firmware" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."firmware") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."address" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."address") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."onvif_uuid" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."onvif_uuid") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."mac" IS NULL OR "capture_devices"."mac" ~ '^[0-9A-F:]{17}$')

constraints.name: capture_devices_adapter_pairing_check
constraints.definition: ("capture_devices"."kind" = 'CAMERA' AND "capture_devices"."adapter_kind" IN ('ONVIF_RTSP', 'FAKE', 'LOCAL_DEVICE')) OR ("capture_devices"."kind" = 'MIC' AND "capture_devices"."adapter_kind" IN ('USB_AUDIO', 'FAKE', 'LOCAL_DEVICE')) OR ("capture_devices"."kind" = 'POE' AND "capture_devices"."adapter_kind" IN ('SNMP_POE', 'FAKE'))

constraints.name: capture_devices_profiles_code_check
constraints.definition: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("capture_devices"."profiles") = 'array' THEN NOT jsonb_path_exists("capture_devices"."profiles", 'strict $[*]?(@.type() != "string" || !(@ like_regex "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$"))') ELSE false END

constraints.name: capture_config_slot_pair_check
constraints.definition: (("capture_config"."video_01_device_id" IS NULL) = ("capture_config"."video_01_profile" IS NULL)) AND (("capture_config"."video_02_device_id" IS NULL) = ("capture_config"."video_02_profile" IS NULL))

constraints.name: transcript_chunks_done_check
constraints.definition: ("transcript_chunks"."status" <> 'DONE') OR ("transcript_chunks"."segments" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_chunks"."computed_at" IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: transcript_chunks_ref_check
constraints.definition: ("transcript_chunks"."embedding_ref" IS NULL OR "transcript_chunks"."embedding_ref" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$') AND ("transcript_chunks"."model_id" IS NULL OR "transcript_chunks"."model_id" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$')

constraints.name: transcript_revisions_signature_check
constraints.definition: "transcript_revisions"."signature_algorithm" IN ('Ed25519', 'SIMULATED-SHA256') AND (("transcript_revisions"."signature_algorithm" = 'SIMULATED-SHA256' AND "transcript_revisions"."signature_simulated") OR ("transcript_revisions"."signature_algorithm" IN ('Ed25519') AND NOT "transcript_revisions"."signature_simulated"))

constraints.name: stt_config_credential_check
constraints.definition: ("stt_config"."credential_kind" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."credential_ref" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."secret_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."nonce" IS NULL) OR ("stt_config"."credential_kind" = 'REFERENCE' AND "stt_config"."credential_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "stt_config"."secret_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."nonce" IS NULL) OR ("stt_config"."credential_kind" = 'ENCRYPTED' AND "stt_config"."credential_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "stt_config"."secret_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "stt_config"."nonce" IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: session_capture_sources_pairing_check
constraints.definition: ("session_capture_sources"."slot" IN ('VIDEO-01', 'VIDEO-02') AND "session_capture_sources"."adapter_kind" IN ('ONVIF_RTSP', 'FAKE', 'LOCAL_DEVICE')) OR ("session_capture_sources"."slot" IN ('MIC-PRIMARY', 'MIC-STANDBY') AND "session_capture_sources"."adapter_kind" IN ('USB_AUDIO', 'FAKE', 'LOCAL_DEVICE'))

constraints.name: core_media_store_root_check
constraints.definition: char_length("core_media_store"."media_root") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 AND "core_media_store"."media_root" ~ '^/[^[:cntrl:]]*$' AND position('://' in "core_media_store"."media_root") = 0

constraints.name: capture_device_streams_size_check
constraints.definition: ("capture_device_streams"."width" IS NULL AND "capture_device_streams"."height" IS NULL) OR ("capture_device_streams"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "capture_device_streams"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "capture_device_streams"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384 AND "capture_device_streams"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384)

constraints.name: capture_audio_inputs_input_check
constraints.definition: "capture_audio_inputs"."input_number" BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "capture_audio_inputs"."native_channels" BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "capture_audio_inputs"."input_number" <= "capture_audio_inputs"."native_channels"

constraints.name: capture_network_config_factory_addresses_check
constraints.definition: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("capture_network_config"."factory_addresses") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("capture_network_config"."factory_addresses") <= 32 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("capture_network_config"."factory_addresses", 'strict $[*]?(@.type() != "string" || !(@ like_regex "^[0-9]{1,3}([.][0-9]{1,3}){3}$"))') ELSE false END

constraints.name: capture_network_config_onvif_ports_check
constraints.definition: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("capture_network_config"."onvif_ports") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("capture_network_config"."onvif_ports") BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("capture_network_config"."onvif_ports", 'strict $[*]?(@.type() != "number")') AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("capture_network_config"."onvif_ports", 'strict $[*]?(@ < 1 || @ > 65535)') AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("capture_network_config"."onvif_ports", 'strict $[*]?(@ != @.floor())') ELSE false END

constraints.name: host_network_aliases_one_open_key
constraints.definition: ((removed_at IS NULL)) WHERE removed_at IS NULL

constraints.name: host_network_aliases_removed_by_check
constraints.definition: "host_network_aliases"."removed_by" IS NULL OR "host_network_aliases"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: host_network_aliases_remove_reason_check
constraints.definition: (("host_network_aliases"."remove_reason" IS NULL) = ("host_network_aliases"."removed_at" IS NULL)) AND ("host_network_aliases"."remove_reason" IS NULL OR "host_network_aliases"."remove_reason" IN ('EXPIRED', 'MANUAL', 'JOB_DONE', 'BOOT_SWEEP', 'SHUTDOWN', 'NOT_ADDED', 'ADD_UNCONFIRMED'))

constraints.name: installation_acceptances_in_force_key
constraints.definition: ((revoked_at IS NULL)) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

constraints.name: installation_acceptances_steps_check
constraints.definition: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("installation_acceptances"."steps") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("installation_acceptances"."steps") <= 32 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("installation_acceptances"."steps", 'strict $[*]?(@.type() != "object")') AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("installation_acceptances"."steps", 'strict $.**{3 to last}') ELSE false END

constraints.name: installation_acceptances_diagnostics_check
constraints.definition: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("installation_acceptances"."diagnostics") = 'object' THEN NOT jsonb_path_exists("installation_acceptances"."diagnostics", 'strict $.**{5 to last}') ELSE false END

constraints.name: installation_acceptances_revoke_check
constraints.definition: (("installation_acceptances"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("installation_acceptances"."revoked_by" IS NULL)) AND (("installation_acceptances"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("installation_acceptances"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)) AND ("installation_acceptances"."revoke_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("installation_acceptances"."revoke_reason") BETWEEN 5 AND 500)
